description: This file is a TypeScript source file implementing a plugin for Playwright that gathers Git commit information and CI environment details, including functions for fetching git logs, diffs, and CI metadata, and integrating this data into the test configuration.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs debug messages if the environment variable DEBUG_GIT_COMMIT_INFO is set.

methods.name: ciInfo
methods.description: Gathers CI environment information from environment variables for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.

methods.name: gitCommitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the latest git commit information including hash, author, and branch.

methods.name: gitDiff
methods.description: Computes the diff of the current git state, considering CI context and uncommitted changes.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with a timeout and returns the output.
